checkpoints.guidance: Check control mechanisms for environmental aspects unique to STPs, such as emissions (air), sludge disposal (land), and noise from blowers etc

checkpoints.question: STP — Waste Management

checkpoints.question: STP — Gas Hazard Monitoring
checkpoints.guidance: Inspect functional, calibrated portable gas detectors capable of sensing lethal gases like Hydrogen Sulfide (H₂S), Methane (CH₄), and carbon monoxide.

checkpoints.question: STP — Emergency Preparedness - Toxic Gas/Drowning
checkpoints.guidance: Review the schedules and logs for emergency evacuation drills focused on toxic gas inhalation, asphyxiation, or drowning.

checkpoints.question: STP — Personal Protective Equipment
checkpoints.guidance: Check that operators are wearing adequate PPE, including heavy-duty long rubber gloves, gumboots, and respiratory masks

checkpoints.question: STP — Monitoring,measurement,analysis and evaluation- ETP treated water test report
checkpoints.guidance:
i. Valid report for ETP Water test shall be available.
Ii. This reports must be verified by responsible personnel.

checkpoints.question: ETP — Operational Control & SOPs
checkpoints.guidance: Confirm explicit instructions are posted for chemical dosing calculations (e.g., lime, alum, polyelectrolyte) relative to fluctuating influent concentrations.

checkpoints.question: ETP — Monitoring and Measurement
checkpoints.guidance: Review log sheets for hourly tracking of heavy metals, oil and grease levels, high-salinity TDS, and shifting pH ranges

checkpoints.question: ETP — Legal Compliance Monitoring
checkpoints.guidance: Ensure the treated effluent satisfies zero liquid discharge (ZLD) criteria or matches exact statutory parameters before final industrial estate pipeline discharge.

checkpoints.question: ETP — Hazardous Waste Management
checkpoints.guidance: Verify the generation and handling of toxic ETP sludge (chemical sludge). Ensure it is bagged, weighed, and stored in a designated, covered hazardous waste yard with an updated Form-3/Logbook.

checkpoints.question: ETP — Pollution Prevention - Soil/Groundwater
checkpoints.guidance: Inspect the physical integrity of ETP tanks for cracks or chemical leaching. Verify that the chemical unloading section features an impervious floor and a dedicated containment dyke.

checkpoints.question: ETP — Life Cycle Perspective - Outsourced Waste
checkpoints.guidance: Verify valid manifest records (hazardous waste consignment notes) proving safe transfer to an authorized TSDF (Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility)

checkpoints.question: ETP — Hazard Identification - Chemical Handling
checkpoints.guidance: Inspect risk assessments regarding severe chemical burns, toxic fumes, or accidental exothermic mixing (e.g., adding water directly to concentrated acids).

checkpoints.question: ETP — Safety Data Sheets & Labelling
checkpoints.guidance: Confirm that Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for every chemical utilized (e.g., sulfuric acid, caustic soda) are clearly posted in regional scripts

checkpoints.question: ETP — Health Surveillance
checkpoints.guidance: Review medical check-up records of ETP workers
